title: Hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine prophylaxis vs placebo or no prophylaxis for COVID-19
question: In adults exposed to or at high risk of COVID-19, does oral hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine prophylaxis versus placebo or no prophylaxis reduce developing COVID-19?
population: Adults (>=18 years) SARS CoV-2 negative (PCR negative or asymptomatic) at enrolment, in contact with an infected individual or at high risk of exposure, such as healthcare workers.
intervention: Oral hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine, any dose, frequency or duration, as pre- or post-exposure prophylaxis
comparator: No quinines or placebo (including usual care/no prophylaxis)
pubmed_queries: (hydroxychloroquine[tiab] OR chloroquine[tiab]) AND (COVID-19[tiab] OR SARS-CoV-2[tiab]) AND (prophylaxis[tiab] OR prevention[tiab]) AND ("randomized controlled trial"[pt] OR randomized[tiab] OR randomised[tiab])
eligibility_summary: RCTs; adults SARS CoV-2 negative by PCR or asymptomatic at enrolment, exposed or at high exposure risk; oral hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine prophylaxis versus no quinines or placebo. Pseudo/quasi-randomized and non-randomized studies excluded. At least one of the listed infection, symptom, hospitalization, mortality, ICU, compliance or adverse-event outcomes required.

primary_outcome.name: Developing COVID-19
primary_outcome.definition: Developing COVID-19 defined by either symptoms or PCR confirmation.
primary_outcome.primary_status: Proposed benchmark outcome; the meta-analysis does not explicitly designate a single primary outcome.

sources: Cochrane COVID-19 Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL)
WHO International Clinical Trials Registry Platform (ICTRP)
additional_methods: Reference lists of review articles and systematic reviews
search_methods.strategy_note: No publication-status or language restriction. CADTH RCT strategy; exact database strategies referenced in S1-S4 Tables, not reproduced in this XML.

benchmark.scope: Open-access meta-analyses whose included trials are all recent (started 2010 or later) and prospectively registered.
benchmark.scope_note: Benchmark selection scope; not an additional eligibility restriction attributed to the comparator meta-analysis.

protocol_ambiguities: Developing COVID-19 is a proposed benchmark focus, not an explicitly designated sole primary outcome; the research question also includes mortality and hospitalization. Captain must adjudicate primary selection.

Eligibility includes chloroquine as well as hydroxychloroquine, although all included trials used hydroxychloroquine. This protocol preserves the methods scope; captain must adjudicate any HCQ-only narrowing.
The research question says placebo, but eligibility allows no quinines and included comparators include usual care/no prophylaxis; eligibility scope is retained.
No common infection assessment timepoint is specified; Table 1 lists follow-up of 2, 12, 4 and 8 weeks. timepoint remains null.
The pooled infection definition permits symptoms or PCR confirmation; PCR-positive-only infection is a separate analysis.
No common intention-to-treat analysis population is specified in the methods.
